classification_definitions.integration: A real project service/API/network/process/store/runtime boundary materially supports the core asserted observable behavior; excludes incidental fixture I/O.
classification_definitions.unit: Local validation/decoding/concurrency/logging or mock-only synthetic behavior, including pre-I/O guards and incidental storage setup/lookups that do not materially establish asserted behavior.
classification_definitions.mixed: Independent unit-only assertion blocks coexist with materially genuine boundary assertions; each named in reason.
classification_definitions.unresolved: Mapping or connected source evidence insufficient; distinct from runtime UNKNOWN.
